ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage scattered as discrete marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dark-based ventral surface featuring high-frequency, low-diameter white focal spots and linear clusters distributed across both lobes, with a higher density of white marks near the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central vertex; approximately 45-degree angle with high vertical-to-horizontal bounding box ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations and peaks along the right lobe trailing edge; left lobe exhibits more moderate, lower-frequency variations with distinct peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex mathematical curves fitted to the superior edges, tapering toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular white pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) scattered across the medial and lateral surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing as thin unaligned scratches, most prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, non-uniform indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
